collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — ROLE MODELS AND GOOD EXAMPLES, RM-41 to RM-90 (draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Fifty more events continuing your "Role Models and Good Examples — 40 Events". Same shape as yours: a SETUP, choices A-D (a few have three), and two possible outcomes per choice; the game picks one outcome from the chosen choice.
collection.description: A thin stray dog keeps appearing near the cooking fires, and a few children have started shooing it away.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A thin stray dog keeps appearing near the cooking fires, and a few children have started shooing it away by waving sticks and shouting.

choices.label: Ask the Children to Stop and Watch.
Leave Scraps at the Edge of the Clearing.
Ask a Healer to Look at the Limp.
Let the Children Help Make It a Sleeping Place.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The children notice the dog is limping and quietly put their sticks down.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: One child keeps shouting, so an adult takes them aside and explains that the dog is frightened, not wicked.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: The dog eats and lies down in the shade, keeping a careful distance from everyone.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: Several village chickens reach the scraps first, and the dog waits for another evening.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The healer finds a thorn in its paw and removes it while a calm villager holds the dog.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: The dog will not let anyone near, and the healer recommends patience over force.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: The children line an old basket with leaves, and the dog uses it the very first night.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: The dog ignores the basket entirely and sleeps under a canoe instead, to the children's amusement.
